reason: When I need fabric for an order date I go back to the Allegro sellers who have already delivered on time for me. Nothing here tells me what is actually in stock or how fast it ships. A good price per metre doesn't help if the parcel arrives after my deadline.
objection: I'm afraid I'd order the velour for a client job and find out after paying that it's on pre-order or out of stock, and then I've lost the days I needed.
would_change_my_mind: Live stock numbers per colour plus a guaranteed next-day dispatch, ideally on an Allegro Smart listing, so I know it will be on my table on time.
